maya: Quick async standup for the v2 routing rollout — posting what I know, please chime in with 1) what you did, 2) blockers, 3) plans for today. We want to keep canary at 2% for another 2 hours unless any red flags.

chris: What I did: kicked off canary at 2% (config `ff:v2-routing:enabled=true` slice A). Observed baseline latency + brief perf spike during first 10m then settled.
Blockers: noticed a small rise in KV cache miss rate for long contexts (~15% -> 22%). Investigating whether batching config needs tweak.
Today: will toggle `batch.window_ms` from 8 -> 6 for the canary and watch p95. Ping me for reviews on the batching PR.

alex: What I did: added extra debug logging for the cache path and increased eviction threshold on one node group. No disk/oom signs.
Blockers: none critical, but we'll need to coordinate if we expand canary to 10% (ops will want a slowstart).
Today: running `promtail` collection for the new logs and correlating misses with sequence length.

deploy-bot: deploy started by chris at 1976543210 — canary rollout 2% -> route slice A. Job ID: `deploy-2026-03-17-1732`.

chris: quick metrics snapshot after 25m: 
```
requests: +2k
p50: 43ms
p95: 210ms -> 225ms (baseline 200ms)
errors: 0.12% (mostly rate-limited clients)
kv_miss_rate: 22%
```
I think p95 creep is tied to cache misses + one noisy client. I'm opening a short-lived CIDR rule for that client to test.

tasha: Product note: keeping the flag behind the new UX gating. No user-facing changes until we hit 10% and run the UX smoke tests. I synced with support; they'll standby for any regressions.

maya: blocker flag: if p95 stays >220ms for next 30m we consider rollback to v1 routing. Also @chris please add a health check that fails if kv_miss_rate > 30% for 5m. Ops needs an automated trigger.

chris: will add healthcheck and the short CIDR test. Also pinging @alex for SRE review on the healthcheck thresholds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1287 (small).

alex: looking now. Also note: if we roll forward to 10% we should stagger from 2% -> 5% -> 10% over 45m with a 10m observation window each. Ops runbook updated in Confluence.

maya: thanks — last: anyone blocking a canary rollback? If not, plan is continue at 2% and reconvene in this thread at +60m for decision. :thumbsup:

chris: no blockers for rollback, ready to flip if healthcheck trips. I'll post another snapshot in 30m.

deploy-bot: canary health check OK at 1976543289 — no automatic rollback triggered.

maya: perfect. tagging this thread for async follow-ups and CR pings. If you need live, I'm on call room `#standup-ops` for quick huddle.
